findings.text: The claim that all three commands exit 0 on the committed revision is unsupported by the log it cites: logs/gate.txt names rev 41ef8974aee8 (the base) on its first line and was written six minutes before commit d048dc5a, so a reader checking the named log finds a different revision; re-run the gate at the commit and cite that log, or reword the claim.

The ReceiptRow docstring still says each section is None when its source did not produce a reading on this tick, which the refused job read violates -- its section is a marker dict, not None -- so the third place the fragment names as carrying the stale contract was left uncorrected and the plan section's stated-contract limb is only partly met.

The record-boundary assertions exercise the command-failed marker only; an absent squeue command (resolve_command -> COMMAND_ABSENT) is asserted at section level in tests/test_node_probe.py:535 but never through the row record, so that spelling of the distinction the done-when names is the one left unasserted.

item_verdicts.diff: The change to imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py is docstring and comment text only -- no executable statement changed -- so the landed behaviour is the base behaviour, and the new sentences agree with node_probe.read_jobs, which returns the marker dict when a due read refused and the hostname/count/jobs dict otherwise.
item_verdicts.done_when: The new tests/test_receipt_section_contract.py asserts at the record boundary that a refused read and a tick whose read was not due serialise to different rows (line 59), that the marker arrives with no count and no rows (lines 75-78), and that a real reading carries a count and no marker (line 97); an absent squeue source (resolve_command -> COMMAND_ABSENT) is asserted only at section level in tests/test_node_probe.py:535, not through the row record.
item_verdicts.goal: The plan section's target -- the recorder's stated contract matching what it does, with the failed-read marker named -- is met for the two carriers the new sentence rewrites: the module docstring and the ROW_SECTIONS comment now name the job table's marker (unread) as the one exception to a present key being a present measurement; but the ReceiptRow class docstring, which the evidence fragment names as a third carrier, was not corrected and still states the superseded rule.
item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed run's manifest.md records status complete, commit d048dc5a, the three changed paths, the gate command with its 46-passed result, and the negative control with its log; it names no baseline_suite or after_suite field, so the added-failure count is stored unmeasured rather than as a zero, which is the legitimate state for a node whose gate is a focused pair of test files rather than a suite pair.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Commit d048dc5a touches exactly the three declared paths (imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py, tests/test_receipt_section_contract.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-recorded-field-is-one-that-was-measured/arf-receipt-section-contract.html; 3 files, +194/-4) and nothing else; the reviewed worktree is clean at that revision.

justifications.durability: The tests are behavioural at the record boundary and two of the three go red under the declared mutant, so a regression that drops the marker fails a named test; the command-absent branch of the same distinction is left to the section-level tests at tests/test_node_probe.py:534-535.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the gate at d048dc5a in the reviewed tree (46 passed, exit 0) and the negative control at logs/negative_control.txt is genuinely red (2 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1), but the fragment's claim that all three commands exit 0 on the committed revision cites logs/gate.txt, whose first line names rev 41ef8974 (the base, six minutes older than the commit).
justifications.fit: The change lands exactly where the plan section places the defect, names the marker through node_probe.UNREAD_KEY rather than a literal, and its one production call site (imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py:519, reached from imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2641) is inert under a docstring-only edit.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The contract now names the marker and the record-boundary test pins it (tests/test_receipt_section_contract.py:59-97), but imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py:183 still states the superseded rule for every section, so the stated contract does not yet fully match the recorder.
justifications.scope_discipline: Exactly the three declared paths were changed, the commit stages them individually, the worktree is clean, and the container directory holds only the real worktree after the run's path-mangling strays were removed before the commit.
